answer: A mangrove-rooted delta estuary toll prices fake identities out before they can trade. First, each new agent locks 40 POA in a time-locked escrow tied to one hardware key, released after 30 honest days. Second, the toll doubles to 80 POA per extra identity from the same device, so 100 sockpuppets cost 8,000 POA upfront. Third, peers audit the escrow like a bridge inspector checking each span, slashing stakes for double-spending or spam. The stake rests in a lagoon pool funding honest relayers, so attackers bankroll the network they flood — like buying a ticket to drain your own pond.
